# Pagination

Composes page navigation from numbered links, previous/next controls and ellipses. The host supplies destinations, the active page and pagination logic; the component does not fetch or slice data.

- **Import:** `import { Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationEllipsis, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationNext, PaginationPrevious } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/navigation-pagination--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Pagination,
  PaginationContent,
  PaginationEllipsis,
  PaginationItem,
  PaginationLink,
  PaginationNext,
  PaginationPrevious,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function PaginationExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Pagination>
        <PaginationContent>
          <PaginationItem>
            <PaginationPrevious href="#" />
          </PaginationItem>
          <PaginationItem>
            <PaginationLink href="#">1</PaginationLink>
          </PaginationItem>
          <PaginationItem>
            <PaginationLink href="#" isActive>
              2
            </PaginationLink>
          </PaginationItem>
          <PaginationItem>
            <PaginationLink href="#">3</PaginationLink>
          </PaginationItem>
          <PaginationItem>
            <PaginationEllipsis />
          </PaginationItem>
          <PaginationItem>
            <PaginationNext href="#" />
          </PaginationItem>
        </PaginationContent>
      </Pagination>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Pagination

Its props are `PaginationProps`, which is `React.ComponentProps<"nav"> & { "aria-label"?: string }`.

- `aria-label`: `string`, optional, default `"pagination"`.

  Defines a string value that labels the current element.
  The navigation landmark's accessible name. "pagination" by default; a
  product that translates passes its own.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## PaginationContent

It forwards its ref to `HTMLUListElement`. Its props are `Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLUListElement>, HTMLUListElement>, "ref">`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## PaginationLink

Its props are `PaginationLinkProps`, which is `{ isActive?: boolean } & Pick<ButtonProps, "size"> & React.ComponentProps<"a">`.

- `isActive`: `boolean`, optional.
- `size`: `"sm" | "lg" | "default" | "icon" | null`, optional, default `"icon"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## PaginationItem

It forwards its ref to `HTMLLIElement`. Its props are `Omit<React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>, HTMLLIElement>, "ref">`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## PaginationPrevious

Its props are `PaginationPreviousProps`, which is `React.ComponentProps<typeof PaginationLink> & { label?: string; "aria-label"?: string }`.

- `isActive`: `boolean`, optional.
- `size`: `"sm" | "lg" | "default" | "icon" | null`, optional.
- `aria-label`: `string`, optional, default `"Go to previous page"`.

  Defines a string value that labels the current element.
  The link's accessible name, which a screen reader says in place of
  `label`. "Go to previous page" by default; a product that translates
  passes its own, one that contains `label`'s word.

- `label`: `string`, optional, default `"Previous"`.

  The word drawn beside the chevron. "Previous" by default; a product that
  translates passes its own, and an `aria-label` in the same language.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## PaginationNext

Its props are `PaginationNextProps`, which is `React.ComponentProps<typeof PaginationLink> & { label?: string; "aria-label"?: string }`.

- `isActive`: `boolean`, optional.
- `size`: `"sm" | "lg" | "default" | "icon" | null`, optional.
- `aria-label`: `string`, optional, default `"Go to next page"`.

  Defines a string value that labels the current element.
  The link's accessible name, which a screen reader says in place of
  `label`. "Go to next page" by default; a product that translates passes
  its own, one that contains `label`'s word.

- `label`: `string`, optional, default `"Next"`.

  The word drawn beside the chevron. "Next" by default; a product that
  translates passes its own, and an `aria-label` in the same language.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## PaginationEllipsis

Its props are `React.ComponentProps<"span">`.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
